entities.name: Albert Auguste Perdonnet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Albert Vincent Auguste Perdonnet was a French railroad engineer. He published the first French textbook on railroad engineering in 1828. He also worked to investigate and remove the causes of railroad accidents.
